The background is plain.

They are wearing a long, tattered overcoat and loose pants that gather around the boots at their feet. The figure holds a cane or walking stick in one hand. artworks.description: The image shows an elderly person standing in profile, holding a cane in one hand and a container in the other. The person has a hood or headscarf covering their hair, and is wearing a long robe tied at the waist with a sash. The background is plain.

Their facial features include a broad nose, full lips, and a beard. artworks.title: Beggar with Dog

The person wears a robe with a girdle, a pouch at the waist, and simple footwear. The background is plain, with no other elements visible.

artworks.title: Beggar Eating
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated in a contemplative position. He is inspecting an object held in his left hand, possibly a bowl or cup. The man has a long beard, a mustache, and wears a cloth cap. He is dressed in a robe, cloak, and soft shoes, and holds a staff in his right hand. The background is plain, focusing attention on the man.

artworks.title: Old Woman with Cats
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a stool facing sideways. They are adjusting an object on their shoulder. The individual has nondescript facial features and their head is covered. The person is wearing layered, draped clothing. A small animal is curled up at their feet. There is a round container nearby. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Gloriosissimae"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious-themed design featuring multiple classic motifs and Latin inscriptions. The central focus includes text written in Latin praising the Virgin Mary, or 'Gloriosissimae Virginis Deiparae Elogium'. Around the central text are four cherubs holding oval-shaped medallions that contain detailed scenes likely depicting biblical or allegorical imagery. The scenes include the crucifixion of Jesus, visions of Mary, a pastoral scene, and a heavenly vision. The drawing utilizes fine lines and detailed shading in a traditional engraving technique, typical of the Baroque period, capturing religious iconography and symbolism.

artworks.title: Frontispiece of the Holy Apocatastase
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 10 cm (5 7/8 × 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and symbolic title page. The title page is detailed, featuring classical architectural elements such as columns and pediments. At the center is a crest with illustrative figures around, including two cherubs sitting atop the pediments. They hold within a glowing radiant vignette. Below them are classical figures dressed in detailed robes and holding objects like scrolls or staffs stand beside the columns. In the middle is the title text in French, surrounded by decorative flourishes and baroque style graphics. Below the title, there is an ornate coat of arms or emblem framed within a decorative cartouche. This drawing is in the style of early 17th-century European engravings, featuring intricate designs and calligraphy.

artworks.title: The Great Rock
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.8 × 27.5 cm (7 13/16 × 10 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a coastal scene with rocks rising from the water. The rocks are intricately detailed with a style reminiscent of etching or engraving. In the background, the ocean meets the sky with small architectural structures on the rocks. Several boats float on the water, and there are birds in the sky. A ribbon with Latin text is carried by one bird. The color palette is monochromatic, and a decorative banner at the bottom encloses a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Two Society Women
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.4 cm (2 3/8 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures of women dressed in elaborate period attire. The woman on the left is facing forward, displaying her full costume with a voluminous skirt and puffed sleeves. Her hair is styled with an intricate headdress featuring ribbons or feathers. The woman on the right is shown from the back, turning slightly to the left, holding a fan in her right hand. Her dress closely resembles that of the first woman, with a similar skirt and detailed upper garment. She wears a hat or adornment in her hair, which is styled up. The background is a simplistic sketch depicting buildings and a couple of figures, with one figure on horseback, suggesting a town setting. Trees and architectural structures are visible, giving a sense of depth and place to the scene.

artworks.title: The Winder and the Spinner
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 8.2 cm (2 5/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two seated figures engaged in spinning yarn. The drawing shows two individuals facing each other, each working with tools for spinning yarn. One person is seated on a low stool, holding a hand distaff or spindle, while the other is attached to a spinning wheel or rack. The scene is simple, with minimal background detail, focusing attention on the activity and equipment used. The style of the line work suggests fine detailing typical of delicate etchings. The figures' attire appears to be historically styled, reflecting clothing from an earlier era. The texture and precise lines provide a sense of quiet concentration and domestic industriousness. The signature "J. Callot inf." in the lower left corner indicates the artist's involvement.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Apostles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.7 × 5.7 cm (3 1/16 × 2 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in front of classical architecture ruins. The image depicts several figures gathered outdoors, surrounded by ancient, crumbling architecture with prominent columns and stone details. Engraved lines and shading create the sense of depth and texture, with a focus on the drapery of the garments and the expressions of the figures. The setting implies an interaction or event of significance, framed by the ruins in the background.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.8 × 6 cm (3 1/16 × 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with an archway framing a table and a group of figures. The drawing depicts an architectural space with a large, ornate archway framing a long table encircled by several figures. The focus appears to be on the figure at the center of the table. The setting is detailed with emphasis on the lines of the vaulted ceilings and the intricate design of the arch above. The drawings of the people seated at the table exhibit varied positioning, which adds to the dynamic sense of interaction within the scene. The overall composition is both balanced and symmetrical, centered under the elaborately rendered archway.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.6 × 7.1 cm (3 3/8 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring angels and light beams. The scene includes a figure holding a cross surrounded by swirling clouds and radiant light. In the foreground, there are figures kneeling and lying on the ground. On the right side, there is a tree bent in the wind, and in the background, there is a structure with a fence and gate. The detailed lines and shading convey both the intensity of the heavenly vision and the serenity of the foreground.

artworks.title: The Betrayal
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 × 7 cm (3 7/16 × 2 3/4 in.)

The figures have dynamic gestures and expressions, some holding swords and staffs, near a large structure with a domed roof, surrounded by trees. The lines are detailed, suggesting movement within the scene. Sparse elements like bending trees and the building enhance the drama, creating an impression of urgency or conflict.

artworks.title: Christ Condemned to Death by Pilate

The architecture features arches, a portico, and statues. The composition features figures engaged in an action with a shield marked with "S.P.Q.R." The drawing style is meticulous with fine lines and detailed rendering.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 × 7 cm (3 7/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing figures inside a stone structure. The scene includes a group of figures in motion within a large arched stone building or chamber. The structure has a cylindrical shape with a wide archway leading into the scene. The figures are shown engaged in various actions, such as extending limbs or holding objects resembling scythes. An intense aura surrounds the central figure. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatched lines, creating depth and texture. The dynamic poses suggest a sense of urgency and drama within the setting.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas

The composition includes distinct structures with complex textures, possibly towers or large residences, displaying timber work or stone facades. A flag with the letters "SPQR" is visible. The drawing emphasizes depth and perspective with detailed line work.
